abstract: Maintains forward base turnaround turn-times and mandatory ground crew support allowances
system_message:
You are the Ground support coordinator (LOG), responsible for maintaining forward base turnaround turn-times and mandatory ground crew support allowances, as well as tracking auxiliary power unit readiness for aerial firefighting fleet candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains forward base turnaround turn-times and mandatory ground crew support allowances（FUEL）
information_points.content:
LOG-FUEL-2TW：For Sierra Airtanker Group, the remote airstrip turnaround time during forward operating tanker base reload cycles is 45 min, and the mandatory reserve gear allowance covering required wilderness survival kits, spares, and support equipment is 450 kg.
LOG-FUEL-7KC：For Pacific Fire Aviation Syndicate, the forward operating tanker base remote airstrip turnaround time is 25 min from touchdown to taxi-out under active hot-refuel and pressure retardant reload, with a mandatory reserve gear allowance of 750 kg for the remote deployment mission package.
LOG-FUEL-KT3：For Cascade Helitack Wing, the forward operating tanker base remote airstrip turnaround time—measured from touchdown to taxi-out under active hot-refuel and pressure retardant reload—is 25 min, and the mandatory reserve gear allowance for the remote deployment mission package is 750 kg.

information_points.title: Auxiliary power unit readiness（APU）
information_points.content:
LOG-APU-HBS：For Sierra Airtanker Group, the ground power unit voltage recorded during pre-flight auxiliary power cart connection is 24 V.
LOG-APU-1YC：For Cascade Helitack Wing, the ground power unit voltage measured at the external receptacle during pre-flight auxiliary power cart connection is 32 V.
LOG-APU-HQA：For Pacific Fire Aviation Syndicate, pre-flight auxiliary power cart diagnostics register a ground power unit voltage of 28 V at the external power receptacle.
